preconditions.description: The input tree is not empty.
The root node is an instance of TreeNode.

postconditions.description: The result is within the specified range of possible sums.

postconditions.expression: all(maxPathSum(root.left) if root.left else True for root in [root]) and all(maxPathSum(root.right) if root.right else True for root in [root])
postconditions.description: The function is recursively applied to all nodes in the tree.

postconditions.expression: result == max(sum(path) for path in all_paths_from_leaf_to_root(root))
postconditions.description: The result is the maximum sum among all paths from any leaf to the root.
